fields.description: Pearlside Marina Residences brings one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments to Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Its plans include compact balcony apartments and larger homes with private yards or terraces, making the outdoor component particularly important when comparing advertised total areas.

overview: The two-bedroom example includes a yard; the three-bedroom example has a large terrace. Compare outdoor and enclosed areas separately.
research.locationNote: Located at Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. The brochure presents the marina and island setting; access arrangements, surrounding works and the selected home’s actual outlook should be confirmed independently.
research.priceLabel: Portal launch guide · not a current offer
research.priceNote: Property Finder records a rounded AED 1.4 m launch guide. This is historical marketing information, not confirmed stock or a current quotation. The previously linked Sobha page currently shows a different project and supplies no reliable current Pearlside price.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% down payment, 50% construction and 40% handover; Bayut instead reports 20/40/40. Neither is adopted as an authoritative current schedule. Obtain a dated developer unit offer before budgeting.
research.handoverNote: The own brochure prints March 2030. FY2025 reports 2029; Property Finder lists September 2030. Confirm dates in writing.
